MoDi Protocol Binary Linking Exception 1.0

Copyright (C) 2026 Silvite.

External distribution status: APPROVED by the owner (Silvite), review completed 2026-08-15.

1. Additional Permission Under GPLv3 Section 7

As a special exception, Silvite, as copyright holder of the covered MoDi
Connect application code, gives permission to link or combine that
GPL-3.0-or-later application code with an Authorized Protocol Binary and to
convey the resulting combined object code under GNU GPL version 3 or any later
version plus this additional permission.

When this exception is active under Section 2, a conveyor may satisfy the
Corresponding Source obligation for the covered application code without
providing Protocol Source, provided that the conveyor otherwise complies with
the GPL for the application and includes every item required by the MoDi
Protocol Binary Redistribution Grant 1.0.

2. Activation Condition

This exception applies to an external application release when the exact
protocol-artifacts.v1.json manifest records EXTERNAL_DISTRIBUTION_APPROVED_BY_OWNER,
approved by the owner (Silvite) on 2026-08-15.

3. Limits

This exception does not change the application itself into proprietary
software, license Protocol Source, excuse compliance for any other GPL-covered
component, or cover a modified, substituted, unverified, or separately
redistributed protocol binary. An Authorized Protocol Binary must match the
version, full source Commit SHA, vector SHA-256, artifact SHA-256, and legal
SHA-256 values in the accompanying manifest.

4. Modified Application Versions

People who modify covered application files may extend this exception to their
versions, but are not required to do so. If they do not, they must remove this
exception statement from their modified version and may not rely on it to
convey a combination with the proprietary protocol binary.

5. Other Rights

This additional permission does not restrict rights that applicable law grants
independently and does not purport to revoke a valid license already obtained
for a previously conveyed copy.
